arabic text: WAFA THI UNKE LIYE AUR YE WAFA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO KARBALA KE LIYE
english translation text: ABBAS WAS LOYAL AND LOYALTY WAS FOR ABBAS\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: HUSSAIN JHULA JHULATE THE, INKO YE KEHKAR\nYE KAAM AYENGE ZAINAB, TERI RIDA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: HUSAYN ROCKED THE CRADLE OF ABBAS AND SAID\nZAINAB HE WILL PROTECT YOUR VEIL IN KARBALA\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: NA JAANE KIS LIYEY HAIDER NE INKE BAZU KE\nHAZAAR BOSE GALE SE, LAGA LAGA KEY LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: I WONDER WHY ALI KISSED THE ARMS OF ABBAS\nAS HE HUGGED HIM AGAIN AND AGAIN\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: JARI KE PERO KO CHUMA HAI ROZ-E-ASHURA\nYE KHUSH NASIB RAHI MOJ-E, ALQAMAA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE,
english translation text: WAVES OF ALQAMA KISSED THE FEET OF BOLD WARRIOR\nON THE DAY OF ASHURA, THIS WAS THEIR GOOD FORTUNE\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: YEH KHIZR-E-RAAHA HAI PARCHAM BHI, INKA RAAHA NUMAA\nSAMANDARO KE SITAARO KE, AUR HAWAA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: ABBAS IS THE SHINNING TORCH, AS IS HIS ALAM IS A GUIDE\nFOR ALL,THE HEAVENS,SEVEN SEAS AND THE WINDS\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: ALAM KE SAAYE MEI AATE HI MILGAYI SEHAT\nTARAS RAHE THE KAHI DIN SE, JO SHAFAA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: AS YOU COME UNDER THE BANNER OF ABBAS\nYOU WILL FIND PEACE AND SHIFA FOREVER\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: SAKINA BABA SE IZN-E-WIGAA DILAHO HAME\nZARA SA KAAM YE KARDO, FAQAT CHACHA KEY LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: SAKINA PLEASE GET ME THE PERMISSION TO GO\nTO THE BATTLE FIELD,DO THIS FAVOUR FOR YOUR UNCLE\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA

arabic text: LAB-E-FARAAT JO BAAZU QALAM HUWE INKE BOHOT BARA THA YE GHAM RUH-E-SAYYEDA KE LIYE\nALI NE MANGA THA GHAZI KO, KARBALA KEY LIYE
english translation text: ON THE BANKS OF THE FURAT HIS ARMS WERE SEVERED\nTHIS WAS A BIG BLOW FOR BIBI SAYYEDA\nALI ASKED FOR A BRAVE WARRIOR FOR KARBALA
